thread:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — final pass on hero lines + inbound routing for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Need: 3 H1 variants per page, CTA text, and recommended lead flow (self-serve vs AE). Also where to surface webinar CTA.
Eli (Product): 👍 Prioritize clarity for engineering buyers. Keep the H1s scannable and include one alt with cost/latency benefit.
Sana (Design): I can mock three hero layouts tomorrow. remind: mobile first, smaller CTAs on mobile.
Maya (Marketing): Drafts below. Short, taggable for SEO. Tell me which to push to a/b and which to keep as the control.
Copybot: Suggested keywords: "inference platform", "hosted API", "dedicated inference", "private deployment", "low latency LLM"
Maya (Marketing): HOSTED API — options:
```
1) "Hosted inference API for production-grade LLM apps"
2) "Low-latency, scalable text generation — no infra required"
3) "Ship smart LLM features with a hosted inference API"
```
Sana (Design): 1 feels product-y, 2 is benefit-forward (latency+scale), 3 is more developer/PLG. My preference: A/B test 1 vs 2.
Eli (Product): Agree A/B 1 vs 2. Add microline under H1: "Stream responses, function calling, and model routing with predictable pricing."
Maya (Marketing): DEDICATED — options:
```
1) "Dedicated GPU capacity for predictable throughput"
2) "Reserved inference pools with SLA-backed latency"
3) "Commit to capacity, control latency and costs"
```
Oliver (Growth): For Dedicated, emphasize SLA and cost predictability in the hero. CTA: "Request dedicated access" (AE route) vs "Estimate capacity" (self-serve calc). Which converts better?
James (Eng): If we route to AE, include a short qual form asking expected qps and seq length to speed triage. We can prefill model family.
Maya (Marketing): PRIVATE — options:
```
1) "Private deployment: VPC and on‑prem inference"
2) "Keep inference where your data lives — enterprise-grade controls"
3) "Air-gapped, auditable LLM serving for regulated workloads"
```
Eli (Product): For Private, go with variant 2 or 3 for enterprise pages. Variant 3 is good for regs (healthcare/finance). CTA should be "Contact sales" or "Schedule a compliance review".
Sana (Design): We should include a subtle badge for "KMS / HSM support" and "SOC2" under the hero for Private.
Maya (Marketing): Quick CTA matrix idea:
- Hosted: primary CTA "Get started — free credits" (self-serve). Secondary "See benchmarks" (page anchor)
- Dedicated: primary CTA "Request capacity" (AE). Secondary "Run estimate" (self-serve)
- Private: primary CTA "Contact sales" (AE). Secondary "Security docs" (link)
Oliver (Growth): Can we gate AE CTAs with lightweight qualification? i.e., if company size <50 show self-serve form, else show AE route. We have the data from signup.
James (Eng): Yes, we can route by metadata. Keep a fallback where AE forms go to new pipeline in HubSpot with source=website-hero.
Maya (Marketing): Webinar placement: add a slim strip under Hosted hero: "Live webinar: building LLM features with Redwood — Apr 22" with CTA "Register". Also include inline on Dedicated page: "Join our deep dive for infra teams" — drives MQLs.
Eli (Product): Measurement plan: A/B test Hosted hero 1 vs 2 for 2 weeks, track: signups (self-serve), webinar regs, bounce rate. For Dedicated/Private track AE form submits and MQL to SQL conversion.
Maya (Marketing): Tiny legal note: product claims must avoid absolute numbers. e.g., don't say "5x faster" unless we have benchmark. Use "up to" if we have backing. @Eli can you confirm any benchmarkable claims we can use?
Eli (Product): We have benchmark for 2 model families on N1 GPUs. I'll share one-liners later today.
Sana (Design): I'll push mocks with the three hero variants each and the CTAs. Expect a Figma link by EOD.
Oliver (Growth): For inbound routing, I'll produce the HubSpot flows: AE pin for Dedicated/Private with tags [product:deds|private], source=website, campaign=hero-test.
Maya (Marketing): Great — final asks: 1) pick A/B winners by Fri 2) finalize CTA text 3) confirm routing & HubSpot mappings 4) add webinar strip to Hosted control. Anyone blocking?
James (Eng): No blockers from infra. We'll have the routing hooks and an event named `website_hero_cta_click` ready.
Eli (Product): I'll confirm benchmark language by 4pm.
Copybot: Tip: keep hero H1 under 70 characters for SEO and mobile.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — I'll consolidate and circulate copy doc + Figma link when Sana shares. :rocket:
Sana (Design): Figma link posted in thread when ready.
Oliver (Growth): I'll draft the HubSpot playbook and share for review.
Maya (Marketing): Closing this thread — will open a follow-up for the A/B results after 2 weeks.
